declared.title: The Own and Social Effects of an Unexpected Income Shock: Evidence from the Dutch Postcode Lottery
declared.foundIn: counter-evidence report reports/money-happiness/counter-evidence.md; OpenAlex search « own and social effects of an unexpected income shock Dutch postcode lottery » (2026-11-22)

population: Dutch households in winning and nearby non-winning postcodes, surveyed 6 months after; prize about 8 months of income

findings.text: Six months after winning (about eight months of income), households are not happier, and neighbours are not less happy

support.sentence: Six months after the fact, winning the lottery does not make households happier, nor do neighbors' winnings reduce happiness.
support.readBy: dossier agent (money-happiness), NBER w14035 PDF, abstract page (the databases' copy has no spaces between sentences)

limits: a working paper (NBER); the published version (AER 2011) has no happiness sentence in its abstract
a one-off windfall, measured once, six months later: says nothing about years
